name: Default
shortDescription: JMAP webmail for Stalwart Mail Server with mail, calendar, contacts and files, configured through a first-run setup wizard.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: the image marks session cookies as secure, so signing in over plain HTTP does not work.
The setup wizard needs a one-time token printed in the container log (valid for one hour; restart the container for a new one). It then asks for your Stalwart server URL and an admin password.

Bulwark needs an existing Stalwart Mail Server with JMAP enabled. Its URL must be reachable both from browsers and from this container (sign-ins are checked server-side), and Stalwart must allow this webmail's domain in its CORS policy.
